# Fruitfly model notices

`brain.js` and `learner.js` are from the `web/` directory of **A fly in the Matrix** by Bernhard Mueller and are distributed under the MIT License in `LICENSE`.

`connectome.json` is a compact derived subset of the upstream browser connectome: the Kenyon-cell and mushroom-body-output network from the adult female Drosophila BANC release 888. The upstream project attributes this connectome to the Lee lab and the BANC community under CC BY. Source records are the BANC release 888 neuron annotations, edge list v3, and neurotransmitter predictions v2. The compact file retains the upstream neuron/synapse values and partitions Kenyon cells into five synthetic Synterra sensor pairs; the sensor labels and action mapping are this project's experimental engineering choices, not biological claims.

Upstream project: **A fly in the Matrix**, hosted at <https://floatingpragma.io/cadence-examples/fly-matrix/>. BANC public data bucket: <https://storage.googleapis.com/lee-lab_brain-and-nerve-cord-fly-connectome/compiled_data/banc_888/>.
